source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Once per turn, 1 unit of yours with this ability may react in the opposing player's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), when an enemy unit picks as an attack target a **KROOT INFANTRY** unit of yours up to 6" from the reacting unit. If it does:

- After the enemy unit finishes its attacks, your reacting unit can shoot as though in your own Shooting phase.
- Those attacks may target only that enemy unit, provided it is eligible to be targeted.

trigger.event: friendly KROOT INFANTRY unit targeted by an attack
